output.reason: A 50-year-old with one day of severe headache, reported fever of 101.5, neck stiffness and photophobia has a plausible bacterial meningitis or other serious intracranial cause requiring immediate emergency assessment, lumbar puncture and possible empiric antibiotics.
output.patientMessage: Go to the emergency department now. Your headache with fever of 101.5, a stiff neck and pain in bright light can mean an infection around the brain, which needs urgent testing and treatment today. Have someone drive you rather than driving yourself. If you become confused, drowsy, have a seizure, or develop a rash, call 911 immediately.
differential: Subarachnoid hemorrhage or other serious intracranial cause

output.vitalSigns: Reported fever of 101.5 by unstated method; heart rate, blood pressure and oxygen saturation not reported.
output.evidenceLimitations: Available passages are emergency-reference syntheses and consumer summaries, with one pediatric-scoped source not applicable to a 50-year-old adult.
